description: This file defines a CustomGuardrail class for managing guardrail behavior, including exception handling, logging, and request/response processing in a language model infrastructure. It includes methods for rendering messages, applying guardrails, and handling guardrail-related metadata.

classes.name: ModifyResponseException
classes.description: Custom exception used to carry a synthetic response for guardrail violations, allowing responses to be replaced or modified.

classes.name: CustomGuardrail
classes.description: Main class for managing guardrail logic, including validation, logging, response handling, and applying guardrails in an async environment.

methods.name: render_violation_message
methods.description: Returns a formatted violation message based on a template, or default if no template is set.

methods.name: raise_passthrough_exception
methods.description: Raises a ModifyResponseException to short-circuit processing and return a violation message.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns None; placeholder for guardrail configuration model.

methods.name: _validate_event_hook
methods.description: Validates that the provided event hook is supported.

methods.name: get_disable_global_guardrail
methods.description: Checks request data and metadata for disabling the global guardrail.

methods.name: _is_valid_response_type
methods.description: Checks if a response is a valid LLMResponseTypes instance, handling TypedDict types safely.

methods.name: get_guardrail_from_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves guardrail configurations from request metadata.

methods.name: _guardrail_is_in_requested_guardrails
methods.description: Checks if the current guardrail is in the list of requested guardrails.

methods.name: async_pre_call_deployment_hook
methods.description: Async hook to process pre-call guardrail logic, possibly modifying request data.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_deployment_hook
methods.description: Async hook to process post-call guardrail logic, possibly modifying response.

methods.name: should_run_guardrail
methods.description: Determines if the guardrail should run based on request data and event type.

methods.name: _event_hook_is_event_type
methods.description: Checks if the event hook matches the current event type.

methods.name: get_guardrail_dynamic_request_body_params
methods.description: Returns dynamic parameters for guardrail API requests based on request data.

methods.name: _validate_premium_user
methods.description: Checks if the user has premium access for certain guardrail features.

methods.name: add_standard_logging_guardrail_information_to_request_data
methods.description: Adds guardrail processing info to request metadata for logging.

methods.name: apply_guardrail
methods.description: Placeholder method for applying custom guardrail logic asynchronously.

methods.name: _process_response
methods.description: Logs guardrail response info and returns the response.

methods.name: _process_error
methods.description: Logs guardrail error info and raises the exception.

methods.name: mask_content_in_string
methods.description: Masks a portion of a string between start and end indices.

methods.name: update_in_memory_litellm_params
methods.description: Updates in-memory parameters for guardrails.

methods.name: get_guardrails_messages_for_call_type
methods.description: Retrieves messages from request data based on call type.
